function applyGameLayout(mode){if(!['grid','duo','focus'].includes(mode))mode='grid';const grid=$('gameGrid');grid.classList.remove('layout-vertical','layout-grid','layout-duo','layout-focus');grid.classList.add(`layout-${mode}`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-layout]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.layout===mode));document.querySelectorAll('.game-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('duo-visible'));let hint='2×2 · quatro sessões';if(mode==='duo'){const second=(focusedSlot+1)%4;document.querySelector(`.game-panel[data-slot="${focusedSlot}"]`)?.classList.add('duo-visible');document.querySelector(`.game-panel[data-slot="${second}"]`)?.classList.add('duo-visible');hint=`1×2 · contas ${focusedSlot+1} e ${second+1}`;}else if(mode==='focus')hint=`1×1 · conta ${focusedSlot+1}`;if($('gameViewHint'))$('gameViewHint').textContent=hint;try{localStorage.setItem('gridiumGameLayout',mode);localStorage.setItem('gridiumGameSlot',String(focusedSlot));}catch{}sendPerformanceView(mode);}

function applyGameLayout(mode){if(!['grid','duo','focus'].includes(mode))mode='grid';const grid=$('gameGrid');if(!grid.classList.contains(`layout-${mode}`)){grid.classList.remove('layout-vertical','layout-grid','layout-duo','layout-focus');grid.classList.add(`layout-${mode}`);}document.querySelectorAll('[data-layout]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.layout===mode));document.querySelectorAll('.game-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('duo-visible'));let hint='2×2 · quatro sessões';if(mode==='duo'){const second=(focusedSlot+1)%4;document.querySelector(`.game-panel[data-slot="${focusedSlot}"]`)?.classList.add('duo-visible');document.querySelector(`.game-panel[data-slot="${second}"]`)?.classList.add('duo-visible');hint=`1×2 · contas ${focusedSlot+1} e ${second+1}`;}else if(mode==='focus')hint=`1×1 · conta ${focusedSlot+1}`;if($('gameViewHint'))$('gameViewHint').textContent=hint;try{if(localStorage.getItem('gridiumGameLayout')!==mode)localStorage.setItem('gridiumGameLayout',mode);if(localStorage.getItem('gridiumGameSlot')!==String(focusedSlot))localStorage.setItem('gridiumGameSlot',String(focusedSlot));}catch{}sendPerformanceView(mode);}
